name: Takayama (Gifu, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takayama city emblem in purple: an angular stylised character with pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Takayama, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 February 1906.

features.role: Takayama city emblem — an angular stylised character with pointed strokes
